items.title: GRC: Unifying Reasoning-Driven Generation, Retrieval and Compression
items.title_zh: GRC：统一推理驱动的生成、检索与压缩
items.summary: GRC unifies reasoning-driven generation, reasoning-enhanced text representation and context compression in a single forward pass using meta latent tokens and a joint generative, representative and compressive tuning approach. It introduces self-reason-latent embeddings and latent memory-augmented generation backed by an O(1)-length internalized KV cache, and reports gains on reasoning-intensive retrieval, generation, document compression and RAG settings.

items.title: ShadowMerge: A Novel Poisoning Attack on Graph-Based Agent Memory via Relation-Channel Conflicts
items.title_zh: ShadowMerge：通过关系通道冲突对图式智能体记忆发起的新型投毒攻击
items.summary: ShadowMerge poisons graph-based agent memory by crafting a malicious relation that shares the query-activated anchor and canonicalized relation channel of benign evidence while carrying a conflicting value. Across Mem0 and the PubMedQA, WebShop and ToolEmu datasets it reports 93.8% average attack success, 50.3 points above the best baseline, and representative input-side defenses were insufficient.

items.title: Open Ontologies: Tool-Augmented Ontology Engineering with Stable Matching Alignment
items.title_zh: 开放本体：基于稳定匹配对齐的工具增强本体工程
items.summary: Open Ontologies is an open-source Rust system that combines LLM-driven ontology construction with formal OWL reasoning and alignment over the Model Context Protocol. Stable 1-to-1 matching reached F1 0.832 on the OAEI Anatomy track, and structured MCP tool access (F1 0.717) far outperformed an LLM reading a raw OWL file (0.323).

items.title: ORACLE: Anticipating Scams from Partial Trajectories in Streaming App Usage
items.title_zh: ORACLE：从流式应用使用中的部分轨迹预判诈骗
items.summary: ORACLE is an agentic framework for anticipating scams from streaming app-usage trajectories, using a self-evolving context manager to consolidate entity-centric interactions and on-policy self-distillation from a teacher conditioned on anti-scam reflections and clues. It is evaluated on a long-horizon benchmark covering 12 scam types, 95 apps and trajectories averaging 15 days.

items.title: Flame3D: Zero-shot Compositional Reasoning of 3D Scenes with Agentic Language Models
items.title_zh: Flame3D：用智能体语言模型对 3D 场景进行零样本组合推理
items.summary: Flame3D is a training-free framework that represents 3D scenes as editable visual-textual memories exposed to an off-the-shelf MLLM through composable spatial tools, and lets the agent synthesize custom spatial programs at inference time. It reports competitive results with finetuned 3D-LMM methods on ScanQA and studies multi-hop compositional reasoning on a curated Compose3D benchmark.

items.title: Agentic MIP Research: Accelerated Constraint Handler Generation
items.title_zh: 智能体式混合整数规划研究：加速约束处理器生成
items.summary: The framework embeds LLM agents in a solver-aware harness to generate, verify and evaluate SCIP constraint handlers, recovering global constraint structures from constraint programming on MIPLIB 2017. It also supports in-context tuning and debugging of generated handlers, and novel propagation methods solved five additional instances.

items.title: Detect, Localize, and Explain: Interactive Hierarchical Log Anomaly Analytics with LLM Augmentation
items.title_zh: 检测、定位与解释：LLM 增强的交互式分层日志异常分析
items.summary: Krone-viz is an interactive visualization system built on Krone's hierarchical log abstraction, which decomposes flat logs into entity, action and status levels for modular anomaly detection with selective LLM reasoning. It lets engineers inspect decompositions, review LLM explanations and revise generated knowledge under human-in-the-loop guardrails, demonstrated on the HDFS benchmark dataset.
